claim_matrix.claim: Wireless JEPA with action-conditioned latent rollouts
claim_matrix.reason: RAN-JEPA and coupled control/wireless JEPA directly implement the core mechanism.

claim_matrix.claim: Physics/mechanistic predictor plus learned residual and same-history counterfactuals
claim_matrix.reason: RAN-JEPA Sections 3.3 and 4.4 directly contain both ingredients.

claim_matrix.claim: Graph topology plus a stochastic latent world model
claim_matrix.reason: GDM combines evolving graph dynamics with an RSSM-style stochastic latent; wireless stochastic latent CSI and telecom graph framing are also explicit.
Native inductive biases are well motivated but are not exclusive to this work.

claim_matrix.claim: Queue, packet deadline or service interruption as native wireless state
claim_matrix.reason: Queues/handover interruption appear in telecom world models; packet waiting/deadline state and deadline metadata are older established mechanisms.

claim_matrix.claim: Delivery-conditioned belief, packet counterfactuals and a defined outage fallback
claim_matrix.reason: WorldGT tracks actual delivered receiver memory and evaluates matched packet counterfactuals, with complete-outage fallback.

claim_matrix.claim: Typed decision probabilities and uncertainty-triggered conventional fallback
claim_matrix.reason: Both are explicit wireless prior art, including task-performance-based credibility checks.

claim_matrix.claim: Baseline-preserving intervention constraints imply a new safety principle
claim_matrix.reason: Baseline bootstrapping and conventional fallback are established. A particular continuation-state invariant may still be useful but needs a precise specification and evidence; generic safe-improvement theory does not transfer automatically.

claim_matrix.claim: One combined graph/JEPA/stochastic/physics/MPC/gate architecture is novel because of the combination
claim_matrix.reason: The closest works overlap at the mechanism and system levels. Combining names does not identify a new estimator, invariant, theorem or experimentally isolated contribution.

claim_matrix.claim: A bounded, recovery-preserving intervention contract plus a learned deadline-service hazard under causal policy-dependent measurement delivery
claim_matrix.reason: These sources cover major components. Potential remaining contribution is the exact estimator/contract and an auditable warehouse benchmark, not the mere use of service/deadline targets. Search coverage does not establish absence.

claim_matrix.claim: State of the art or better than RadioMap/other models across wireless tasks
claim_matrix.reason: Requires matched input/action/compute/task evaluation against strong relevant baselines, independent seeds and held-out sites; paper results on different tasks cannot be ranked as a common leaderboard.

failed_searches.query: wireless graph stochastic latent world model

coverage_limits: At most six ranked results per index query; not exhaustive.
IEEE service-curve lead returned HTTP 202 with an empty body, so its methods remain unreviewed.
No comprehensive IEEE/ACM publisher fulltext search, backward/forward citation closure, patent search, or code-license audit was completed.
Not every section or proof of each retrieved paper was read; exact scopes are recorded.
Preprint availability is not a peer-review or independent-replication certificate.
No model was trained, no external testbed controlled, and no paper baseline reproduced in this literature audit.
reproducibility_comparators_needed: Canonical RadioMap/controller with its original recovery state and equal observation/action budget
Numerical queue/service model plus simple calibrated hazard or Markov baseline
Matched non-JEPA stochastic/recurrent/graph model at equal training and inference budgets
Same model without packet-service targets, without uncertainty, and without the intervention contract
Faithful accessible closest-wireless-model adaptations where code/data rights and task compatibility permit
candidate_claim_boundary: Investigate whether a causally observed deadline-service estimator with a precisely defined bounded intervention and baseline-continuation contract improves warehouse packet outcomes over matched strong baselines. Neither novelty nor an improvement result is established by naming this candidate.
redistribution: Only factual metadata, original paraphrases and fetch/search receipts are included. Downloaded PDFs and extracted fulltexts remain in the execution workspace.
